subject.title: feat: link ClawHub status page from footer

question: Should ClawHub expose the Better Stack status page as a permanent footer platform link?
rationale: The patch is technically straightforward, but the remaining choice is whether this external operational status page belongs in persistent site navigation.

options.title: Accept the footer Status link
options.body: Merge the current narrow implementation because it follows the existing footer link pattern and has focused test coverage.

options.title: Keep status out of the footer
options.body: Close or revise the PR if maintainers prefer status visibility to live in docs, incident communications, or another navigation surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the footer Status link
recommendation.body: Merge the current narrow implementation because it follows the existing footer link pattern and has focused test coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the recent owner for this footer/navigation surface in main history and authored the proposed branch.
